_note: Episode 50 (Season 5 closing, about 2 minutes), story version 2 'Ang Dulo': the rebuilt Philippines, Indio (Season 5 string kept exactly) and M and their child at Pugad Lawin, families everywhere, then the other world at the very beginning: Abel alive, a shepherd seen from the side or behind (never a devotional likeness), with the baby; the dog; the unmarked arm. Everyone clothed. God shown as nothing. Nobody but the narrator speaks. Prompts setting-first; filtered words avoided. Shots follow sentences.json; k90-k95 are extras.
